name: Pelotas

queries.query: Pelotas Brazil official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry public viewer API
queries.result: Found the official GeoPelotas portal and its Prefeitura de Pelotas ArcGIS Hub organization. The portal describes municipal cadastral maps with urban blocks and lots; the public ArcGIS organization exposes a parcel FeatureServer.

queries.query: Pelotas mapa cadastral lotes prefeitura geoprocessamento cadastro imobiliário
queries.result: A busca oficial encontrou o Portal de Informações Geográficas da Prefeitura de Pelotas, which documents digital urban lots and the municipal Serviço de Mapeamento e Informações Geográficas. The current public ArcGIS service was inspected anonymously.

registryEvidence.custodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Pelotas, Serviço de Mapeamento e Informações Geográficas / Secretaria Municipal de Urbanismo
registryEvidence.basis: The official GeoPelotas portal identifies the municipal portal, describes the municipal cadastral lot mapping, and names the Serviço de Mapeamento e Informações Geográficas. Its ArcGIS organization is owned by PMPELOTAS.

officialSources.observation: Redirects to the official GeoPelotas ArcGIS Hub portal; the portal describes urban cadastral blocks and lots and the municipal mapping service.
Current official public portal configuration identifies Prefeitura Municipal de Pelotas as owner and PMPELOTAS as the ArcGIS owner.
Municipal news page identifies GeoPelotas as the Prefeitura's georeferenced-information platform.

requests.outcome: Returned an HTML meta-refresh redirect to the current official ArcGIS Hub portal.
Fetched current public JavaScript/configuration; site item a75c996b6a4d420d9b1ed180efff8552 is public and owned by PMPELOTAS.
Public owner search listed parcel FeatureServers, including lotes_total_tabelao_dez_enderecos_15122021.
Service metadata returned one polygon layer in wkid 102100/latestWkid 3857.
Layer schema exposes native FID, OBJECTID, cod_lote and geometry; only FID/cod_lote were requested, and no unsafe fields were requested.

Anonymous point-intersects query used the exact WUP point in EPSG:4326, returned one Polygon in EPSG:4326 with FID 6184 and native cod_lote B3CG0601000; retained sample contains only canonical properties.id.

source: Prefeitura Municipal de Pelotas GeoPelotas ArcGIS FeatureServer lotes_total_tabelao_dez_enderecos_15122021/0

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Pelotas municipal parcel/lote layer published through the official GeoPelotas ArcGIS organization.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A public layer schema and one exact-point intersect response were verified; this is not a citywide extract or proof of complete coverage.

remainingUncertainty: The official municipal route and one bounded parcel geometry are verified, but complete citywide coverage, update cadence, and production adapter suitability remain unverified. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; the result is not generalized beyond the returned polygon.
